title: Skywatcher's government-funded UAP observation events, four and a half years without psionics
summary: Skywatcher tells of Skywatcher's government-funded UAP observation events, four and a half years without psionics, about c. 2020-2025 (four and a half years) at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, in four of not for half a year there was no psionics in general. We have eight classes with this.

plain: A witness from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call up UFOs, describes about four and a half years, around 2020 to 2025, of field events in the western United States, funded by the government, for watching UAP, a term for unexplained objects in the sky. According to this witness, for that whole stretch they used no psionics, meaning mind-based methods for making contact, and the group says it runs eight classes on this. If true, it would mean the government paid for organized efforts to watch these objects.
